analysis: The only change in this file is at line 313 of EngineV2ProductionWiringTests.swift. The test helper recordServerStream now ignores a new `.logprobs` case of MLXServerGenerationEvent, alongside `.toolCall` and `.toolCallDelta`. This is a test-only edit. It makes the switch exhaustive after an upstream enum addition and ships no production code. It adds no new attack surface and weakens no control. I reviewed the rest of the file in both units: scripted CBv2Engine stubs, KV re-slicing, engine_v2_refusal telemetry, restore-on-throw and the serviceability floor. Those parts are unchanged context and no regression was identified. The change touches none of the threat-model concerns: T-041 prefix cache and SSD tier, TB-002 wire encryption, and TB-011 authorization. Remaining question for integration: the new `.logprobs` event is produced elsewhere, in production code outside this batch. Whether it leaks prompt or completion data (A-001) over the coordinator leg, or bypasses response encryption (T-008), was not visible here. Reviewers of the production-side files should check that. Nothing in this test file bears on that conclusion.
